scientific_integrity: The result is proved by exact Hamiltonian matching and first-hit differentiation; numerical examples and exact-rational computations are supporting checks only.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on an isolated transverse periodic crossing orbit with exactly four switches, two at each of two parallel interfaces.
No criterion for existence, extra-switch cycles, sliding, grazing, or global basins.
Two closely related three-strip cycle-count articles could only be compared at the abstract level; equivalent unstated results remain a priority risk.
Independent external audit has not been performed.
title: Strict hyperbolicity and a coefficient-only stability test for three-strip Hamiltonian crossing cycles
